# [Baseline] - WIN - U - Microsoft Outlook

Configures the user's Exchange Online profile automatically, so that Outlook works without manually adding an account.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | User (U) — assign to user groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | All Users |
| Source | own baseline |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_U_Microsoft_Outlook.json`](Baseline_WIN_U_Microsoft_Outlook.json) |
